note: The seven hash-registered Microsoft XNA Framework 4.0.0.0 assemblies that are the behaviour authority for this binding. Only SHA-256 digests are retained; no Microsoft binary is stored in the repository. The prose registry is docs/xna-swift-mapping.md.
resourceStringNote: A user-visible XNA message is not an IL literal: the code loads a resource KEY and the runtime resolves it against the assembly's own embedded string table. Every message this binding reproduces is therefore read out of the registered binary by tools/api_compat/pinned_assembly_audit.py, pinned in tools/api_compat/reference/xna40-selected-resource-strings.json, and compared against the Swift source by the verifier. Transcribing one from memory is a mapping mismatch even when it looks right -- one already differed by a whole clause and by a double space.

selectedResourceStrings.reason: GameComponentCollection.InsertItem raises ArgumentException with this when the item is already present.
GameComponentCollection.SetItem's whole body is a throw carrying this.
